podcast.title: African Roots
podcast.body: Minto music's traditional sounds originated with "the slaves from Africa." This directly links the genre to the cultural heritage and musical traditions of enslaved African peoples. "based on traditional sounds that came with the slaves from Africa."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Ancient Roots
podcast.body: Minto music is noted to have roots dating back "hundreds of years." This emphasizes its long-standing presence and evolution as a traditional musical form. "Both sounds date back hundreds of years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Jamaican Folk Music
podcast.body: Minto music is described as a form of Jamaican folk music that emerged from Kingston. It is based on traditional sounds brought by slaves from Africa. "Kingston was Minto music, a form of Jamaican folk music based on traditional sounds that came with the slaves from Africa."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
